shell.ribbon: Synthetic demo data. Not real weather.
shell.noLogin: Prototype without login. Officer and Farmer only change the layout.

states.error: Could not load {{what}}. Check the server is running, then try again.

states.notInMockDates: Demo files exist for {{dates}}. Choose one of those dates, or switch this view to the API.

states.renderError: This screen stopped working. Reload the page to try again.

provenance.provisional: Provisional forecast: the corrected block forecast with an uncalibrated range. Not a verified result.
provenance.placeholder: The API sends placeholder numbers for this screen. They are not results, so they are not shown.

map.title: Map explorer
map.noValues: No Panchayat values for this day
map.panelEmptyBody: Choose a Panchayat to see its 5-day forecast, why it differs from its block, and its advisories.
map.unknownPid: Panchayat {{pid}} is not in this district
map.heading: {{variable}}, {{date}}: {{view}}
map.flatNote: Every Panchayat in a block has the same middle estimate for this variable on this day, so this view changes colour only between blocks. Choose Difference from block to see the rest.
map.regionLabel: Map of Panchayats coloured by {{variable}}. For keyboard use, choose Show as table.
map.noWebglTitle: This browser cannot draw the map
map.noWebglBody: WebGL is switched off or missing. Choose Show as table for the same values.
map.riskHint: Not connected yet. Risk layers on the map arrive with the risk screens in a later version.

priority.title: Panchayats needing attention
priority.subtitle_one: Next {{count}} day after the issue of {{date}}
priority.subtitle_other: Next {{count}} days after the issue of {{date}}
priority.summary_one: {{count}} Panchayat at moderate level or above.
priority.summary_other: {{count}} Panchayats at moderate level or above.
priority.emptyBody: No risk reaches moderate level for the issue of {{date}}. Change the date to check another day.
priority.notBuilt: The ranked table with sorting, filters and printing comes in the next version.

review.title: Advisory review
review.emptyBody: No advisories waiting for review for {{date}}. Change the date or run the daily job.
review.notBuilt: The queue, the editor in three languages and the audit trail come in the next version.

verification.title: Forecast accuracy check
verification.notBuilt: No accuracy numbers are shown until the verification job has produced them.

impact.title: Decision replay
impact.notBuilt: Counts of correct, wasted-wait and washed-off decisions are shown once the verification job has produced them.

farmer.emptyBody: Advice appears here after the agriculture officer approves it.
farmer.forecastNotBuilt: The 5-day forecast for your village comes in the next version.
farmer.demoNote: Demo farmer profile. There is no login in this prototype.

bulletin.title: Bulletin for {{pid}}
bulletin.notBuilt: The printable A4 bulletin comes in a later version.

legend.deltaCaption: Panchayat minus block. Zero is white.

panel.chartEmptyBody: The forecast has no {{variable}} numbers for these days.
panel.notInLayer: No value for this Panchayat on this day.
panel.chartLabel: {{variable}} for the next 5 days: likely range, middle estimate and block forecast
panel.sourceTruth: Source: synthetic truth from the demo data generator, not a measurement
panel.sourceNone: No observations exist for this Panchayat.
panel.drySpell: Dry forecast days in a row
panel.explainTitle: Why is it different from the block?
panel.explainDelta: Model average here compared with the block average: {{value}} {{unit}}
panel.explainDeltaNote: The reasons explain this difference. The difference shown at the top compares the middle estimate with the issued block forecast, so the two can differ.
panel.explainEmpty: Nothing to explain: {{variable}} here is about the same as the block average on this day.
panel.explainEnglishOnly: Explanations are in English until a native speaker writes them.
panel.explainMethod: Found by comparing what drives the model here with the rest of the block.
panel.changesNone: No earlier forecast to compare with.

confidence.tipLikely: High confidence: the forecast gives a clear signal for this.
confidence.tipPossible: Medium confidence: the signal is there but could change. Check again tomorrow.
confidence.tipUncertain: Low confidence: treat this as an early warning and check again tomorrow.
